overall_rationale: The active manuscript consistently distinguishes the true-H oracle theorem from the fitted-score CAL guarantee, withdraws unsupported robustness/frontier/mechanism claims, corrects OpenR1 accounting, and gives conservative closest-work positioning. The reviewer-safe bundle replays the main JSON byte-for-byte only conditional on its derived manifest and says that it is not a raw clean-room reconstruction. Fresh pristine dual builds and all required static, replay, snapshot, and visual checks pass. Existing external-evidence gaps remain explicit and are not resolved by this scope correction.

findings.finding: The abstract, Figure 1/caption, contributions, method, limitations, and conclusion reserve exact conditional replay-flip probability and the tower theorem for true H_star. BAYES-H is a distinct Hhat_FIT fitted stopping score; Theorem 2 is explicitly a FIT-frozen, CAL-screened empirical-Bernstein/Bonferroni marginal replay guarantee for a finite family, with TEST descriptive only. The fitted score is never identified as the oracle conditional probability except under Hhat_FIT=H_star.

No active most-robust, frontier/optimality, or mechanism-law claim remains. The E3 alpha=.05, delta=.15 exception is explicit: BAYES-H 5.2% is invalid while FIXED-EB 4.7% remains valid. Margin and drift material is consistently synthetic, exploratory, and nonconfirmatory; the alpha=.10 Table-1 comparison does not bold BAYES-H above FIXED-EB.

OpenR1 is consistently stated as 9,374 raw unique problems, 8,853 retained after the exactly-two-deduplicated-rollout predicate, and FIT/CAL/TEST 3000/3000/2853. The abstract, carrier text, limitations, claim map, recovered output boundary, and static audit agree.

closest_work_round4.md supplies primary-source-scoped comparisons to Rossell--Mueller, Novikov, Ankirchner--Klein, and Waudby-Smith--Ramdas. The residual statement is limited to independent FIT/CAL screening of a frozen plug-in score for exact task-level replay loss; it disclaims a new general confidence sequence, Bayesian stopping principle, optimal stopping result, or priority claim. All 14 active citekeys are lock entries and the request/lock records both report all-active-locked.

All 13 repro_bundle_round4 manifest files match their hashes. The standard-library verifier rebuilt the main JSON byte-for-byte with SHA-256 b114c72d9ab1cf1a6ba1d2bd734433c06bd4d5cbd19bf93be0964edf6fc8a5f7 when conditioned on omr_problem_manifest.json. Manuscript, claim map, and README accurately state that this does not reconstruct omitted raw parquet or locally rerun secondary runners.

Figure 1 is code-native and hash-pinned to its renderer, input manifest, PDF, PNG, and frozen JSON inputs. Its renderer records raw labels at least 8.25pt and an approximately 6.9pt effective minimum at manuscript width; direct 144-dpi page-2 inspection found the 100%-width figure readable with no stray square, clipping, or overlap. The stacked oracle/fitted/CAL caption directions match the figure. Table 5 is headed CAL EB UCB and states FIT-frozen/Bonferroni conditioning.

The active baseline list has exactly one BAYES-UNIF occurrence. No prohibited superlative/law phrase occurs in active TeX. Carrier text says the derived manifest is conditional and not clean-room; correlation wording says the count-only artifact cannot identify a pooled-correlation diagnostic or correlation dominance.

Theorem 1 and Appendix terminal bookkeeping use x_N=K and zero terminal replay flip under the ordinary stopping test. Theorem 2 states independent iid FIT/CAL tasks, conditional FIT freezing, bounded g_r(K), finite J=64 family, per-rule allocation, and Bonferroni; its CAL result remains marginal. Proposition 2 is a capacity-constrained, nondecreasing piecewise-linear TV LP, explicitly rejects global affinity, and correctly proves B_1 is the simplex and V(1)=max_K g(K). The exact-rational monotonicity boundary audit passed 21,824 reversal cases and 11,904 zero-F0 support cases.
